stem.text: The structure of santonin is shown.

stem.label: santonin
stem.alt: Skeletal structure of santonin: a fused ring system with a ketone on a six-membered ring, two methyl groups, and a lactone (five-membered ring with an O and C=O).

stem.text: Santonin is first treated with warm dilute $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$. The product of this reaction is treated with cold dilute acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$. A final product, $Q$, is obtained.
How many atoms of hydrogen in each molecule of product $Q$ will react with sodium metal?
